name: set_display
title: Resize virtual display
description: Change the virtual display geometry at runtime (800-3840 x 600-2160, refresh 30-240) without restarting the daemon or changing the primary monitor. Changes the shared display for all clients in this profile; the display topology changes once, so the user may see a brief flicker. On failure the previous geometry is restored and E_DISPLAY_MODE is returned. reposition=true (default) moves tracked windows that would fall outside back inside.

reposition.description: Default true: move tracked windows that would fall outside the new display back inside it.

fit_windows.description: Default false (or VSP_FIT_MANAGED_WINDOWS=1). When true, tracked windows larger than the new display are resized to fit and their placement is updated.
